messages:
Noah R.: quick sync: we need a control-plane for telemetry gates that teams can use without diving into infra. options: config service, tagged headers, or per-tenant SSM config. thoughts?
Maya T.: config service + tenant overrides seems simplest. per-request headers only for internal migration jobs. public requests must follow tenant config.
Caleb B.: agree. requirement: gate decisions must be auditable and time-bounded. we need a history for when a gate flipped and who approved it.
Ivy Z.: ops: also require cardinality caps and an emergency "soft-fail to passthru" toggle. transforms can break pipelines; safe fallback is essential.
Noah R.: sketch API: POST /gates {gate_id, default_mode, rollout_days, cardinality_limit, backfill_required, approver}. include audit id in response.
Maya T.: example config snippet: ```gate_id:new_kv;mode:transform;rollout:14;card_cap:2000;backfill:true;approver:metrics-team```
Caleb B.: instrumentation: emit metric rdwd.gate.evaluations{gate=...,mode=...} and rdwd.gate.failures. wire alerts when failure rate > 0.5% or cardinality delta > 3x baseline.
ingest-bot: ALERT: previous unbounded-tag rollout increased index size by 40% in staging. Recommend mandatory perf test for any gate with card_cap > 1000. :warning:
Ivy Z.: storage policy: keep raw archive for 30d default, requestable to 90d with billing signoff. backfill ownership: requestor owns backfill plan and cost estimate; billing approves credits.
Noah R.: RFC action: i'll draft control-plane API + example client SDK hooks and an audit/canary checklist. target Wed EOD.
Maya T.: i'll draft the perf-test harness and include synthetic cardinality spike tests.
Caleb B.: i'll add monitoring dashboards and sampling guidance.
Ivy Z.: ops will add an emergency gate to revert transforms at router-level.
Noah R.: perfect. short follow-up after RFC: 30m review to finalize audit fields and approver flows. :thumbsup:
